report.summary: 1 drift finding: threat 'credential database theft' asserts bcrypt at cost 12 but the code now uses Argon2id.

findings.title: Password hashing algorithm changed from bcrypt to Argon2id

model_excerpt.quote: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt at cost 12 in internal/auth/password.go, which keeps offline cracking expensive.

evidence.note: HashPassword now computes password hashes using argon2.IDKey instead of bcrypt at cost 12
VerifyPassword now compares Argon2id derived keys instead of calling bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword

relevance.justification: The threat description makes a concrete claim about the password hashing algorithm and cost parameter that is directly contradicted by the migration to Argon2id.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl: in threat 'credential database theft' (around line 12), update the description to reflect that passwords are now hashed using Argon2id in internal/auth/password.go rather than bcrypt at cost 12.
findings.suggested_fix: Update threat 'credential database theft' description to reference Argon2id hashing instead of bcrypt at cost 12.
